'''Macaroni and nutritional yeast''' is a vegan alternative to macaroni and cheese.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] dry [[Cookbook:Pasta|macaroni pasta]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Nutritional Yeast Flakes|nutritional yeast flakes]]
*3 ½ cups water or [[Cookbook:Rice Milk|rice milk]], boiling
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]

==Procedure==
#Bring 4 [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] of water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], add salt to taste, and add the macaroni.
#Melt the margarine over low heat. [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] in flour with a wire whisk. Continue to beat over medium heat until mixture is smooth and bubbly.
#Whisk in the 3 ½ cups water. Then, add salt, garlic powder, soy sauce, and turmeric to the liquid.
#The sauce should cook until it thickens and bubbles. When that happens, beat in nutritional yeast flakes; if the sauce is too thick, add more water.
#When the macaroni is cooked, drain and add the sauce. Serve immediately.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* For a variation, add mustard to the sauce.
